# pushward_org_devices (Data Source)

Every member's devices, with the organization's tags on each.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pushward_org_devices" "all" {}

output "devices_without_delivery" {
  value = [for d in data.pushward_org_devices.all.devices : d.device_id if !d.delivery]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `app_version` (String) PushWard app version.
- `can_receive_notifications` (Boolean) Whether the device can receive notifications.
- `can_start_live_activities` (Boolean) Whether a Live Activity can be started on the device.
- `created_at` (String) When the device registered.
- `delivery` (Boolean) Whether the organization reaches the device; its owner can switch that off.
- `device_id` (String) Device id.
- `device_model` (String) Hardware model.
- `name` (String) The name the owner gave the device.
- `nickname` (String) The owner's name, if they set one.
- `os_version` (String) Operating system version.
- `platform` (String) `ios`, `ipados`, `watchos`, `macos` or `android`.
- `tag_ids` (Set of String) The organization's tags on the device.
- `user_id` (String) The owner's user id.
